Also the proportional for some characters in the VN text sometimes too long, makes it little bit overwhelming. I will update the review later when I finished playing. But so far It's get the thumbs up for me, but the score a little bit lower due to some issue that I encounter.

This novel is quite different from Re:LieF in terms of art and storytelling style. I love its unique art style and the clean UI. The storytelling is a bit verbose but still enjoyable overall. The non-linear narration, with its frequent jumps between past and present, left me feeling a bit confused at times. Ayame’s route was my favorite. Still, the story leaves a few questions hanging.

So, when's OmegA coming out?

Despite not being a fan of fragmental narrative, I do like the story execution. The soundtracks were incredible and the art style was rather good but honestly, I love the prequel’s art style a bit more. The story is incomplete so be prepared to be confused. I do hope that the developer will try to complete the “Omega” part since the prequel was one of stories that I love the most.
